map.团队名生成器（词库随机组合，无数值计算）：每条候选 = 60% 概率的「风格前缀: Team name generator (random lexicon combination, no numeric computation): each candidate = a 60%-chance style prefix word + 1 random word from the domain lexicon's first part + 1 from its second part, followed by the chosen suffix type (40%-chance lexicon suffix / two-digit number / single symbol / none). Domain and style together select the lexicons; the count slider sets 1-30 candidates, max length is clamped to 6-40 with up to 16 retries and a final truncation if still too long. Randomness: with no seed, crypto.getRandomValues with rejection sampling removes modulo bias; with a seed, FNV-1a hash + mulberry32 reproduces the same batch exactly. Validation: count and length are parsed with parseInt and clamped. Criterion: combination space = (style word count + 1) × first-part count × second-part count × suffix space, with all combinations equally likely for a given input; every name is escaped before output.
map.本工具按选定领域（科技/体育/电竞/创业/创意）与风格（热血/搞笑/专业/古风）: This tool combines English word banks by the selected domain (tech / sports / esports / startup / creative) and style (passionate / humorous / professional / classical). You can set the maximum length, suffix type (lexicon / number / symbol / none) and the number of candidates; entering a random seed reproduces the same batch. Pure word-bank combination cannot guarantee uniqueness — the same bank produces many duplicates, so before official use we recommend searching event or social platforms for name collisions. The lexicons are English only; mixed Chinese-English output and language-style switching are not provided. Generation runs entirely in your local browser with nothing uploaded.
